notablePrerequisites:
Triskelion has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You have a way to give Triskelion lifelink.
description:
Give Triskelion lifelink.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.
